pages.task: Draw the NEW ARCHER in this pose. Image 1 = EXACT character reference: copy face, beard, hair, costume, palette and rendering style identically. Image 2 (old archer) is ONLY a rough body-pose guide, never copy its costume, hood or quiver. Pose: FULL DRAW at anchor: LEFT arm straight forward at shoulder height, RIGHT hand anchored at the cheek/corner of the mouth with elbow pulled back in line with the arrow, shoulders squared, one eye aiming, same stance as the old bow_shot.
